heroAlt: White sand beach with bungalows, pirogues and a turquoise lagoon in Madagascar
heroText: Local guides, handpicked stays and routes planned by people who live here. Tell us your dream trip and get a free quote within one working day.
heroPlanner: A real planner answers you, before, during and after your trip.
waysText: From a single morning on the water to a month on the island, pick the format that fits you.
introTitle: A Local Team, From The First Idea To The Last Sunset
introText: We live in Madagascar and plan every trip ourselves. Routes, drivers, guides and stays are chosen by people who know them personally.
notSureText: Tell us what you love. We suggest the route.

promises.title: Local first
promises.text: Local guides, family-run stays and small restaurants that support the people who make the place special.

promises.title: Slow by design
promises.text: Fewer stops, more time. We leave room for a long lunch, a detour or a swim you did not plan.

promises.title: Honest quotes
promises.text: One clear quote with everything in it. No hidden fees and no surprises at the end.

promises.title: Always reachable
promises.text: A real person before, during and after your trip, who answers when you need it.

regionsText: Madagascar is a continent in miniature. Pick a region to see what it is known for and when to go.

regions.name: The North
regions.tagline: Emerald bays, spice islands and dry forests
regions.text: Sail the bay of Diego Suarez, hike the sharp limestone of Ankarana and finish on the islands around Nosy Be.

regions.name: The Highlands
regions.tagline: Royal hills, rice terraces and cool mornings
regions.text: Start in Antananarivo, climb to the royal hill of Ambohimanga and ride south through the terraced valleys to Antsirabe.

regions.name: The West
regions.text: Drive the famous Baobab Avenue at sunset, then cross the river to walk the Tsingy of Bemaraha.

regions.name: The South
regions.tagline: Canyons, white sand and coastal villages
regions.text: Hike the sandstone canyons of Isalo, swim in natural pools and end the trip on the Vezo coast.

regions.name: The East
regions.text: Listen for the indri at dawn in Andasibe, then take a boat to Ile Sainte-Marie or into the Masoala peninsula.

tripsTitle: Trips We Love To Send You On
tripsText: Ready-made starting points. We adapt each one to your dates, pace and budget.

trips.name: Highlands & Coast
trips.text: From lemur forests to a quiet bay, a slow week that mixes culture, nature and the sea.

trips.name: Island Escape
trips.text: White sand, turquoise water and days that end on a boat.

trips.name: Wild North
trips.text: Baobabs, canyons and empty beaches, for the ones who want more.

servicesText: Book the whole trip with us, or only the part you need. Every service is run by our team and trusted local partners.

quotes.text: They planned every detail, yet the trip never felt planned. It felt like we were visiting friends.
Our guide showed us a side of the island we never expected. The food, the people, the little workshops.
When our flight was cancelled, they had a new plan before we finished our coffee. Impressive.
Having one person to call for everything made our family trip stress-free. The kids still talk about it.

ctaText: Tell us what you love and how long you have. A real planner answers within one working day with a first idea and a free quote.
